title: Parking garage edge column: seismic load combinations (ASCE 7-22)

rubric.text: The response should include Ev = 0.2 SDS D in both seismic combinations and keep the load factor on L at 1.0, because the 0.5L exception does not apply to garages.

expert_notes: Combination 6: (1.2 + 0.2 x 0.8) x 349.3 + 60 + 1.0 x 81 = 475.0 + 60 + 81 = 616.0 kN, governs over 2a (548.8). Combination 7: (0.9 - 0.16) x 349.3 - 60 = 198.5 kN. With 0.5L (not allowed in a garage): 575.5. Without Ev: 6 gives 560.2, 7 gives 254.4.
